annotations.title: Set the default account for a platform

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Sets the brand's default account for one platform (where posts on that platform go when no account is named), or clears it with accountId null. Only the brand's owners and admins can change it, and the account must be one list_connected_accounts shows for that platform. Confirm the account with the user first.
(Wraps PUT /api/v2/accounts/defaults.)

accountId.description: An account id from GET /api/v2/accounts for that platform, or null to clear the default.

name: account_set_default
title: Set the default account for a platform
